name: US Open: Champions of the Court Tennis
desc:
🎾 Welcome to US Open Tennis: Champions of the Court 2026! 🎾
New Update!

👑Compete in the US Open tournament and face off against New York’s finest to become the ultimate tennis champion! 
☀️Defeat the brightest player of all, the sun, for a chance to claim the mythical La Roche-Posay Solarflare Cape UGC!
🏎️Arrive in style with Cadillac 
🎁Earn limited-edition US Open UGC - available while supplies last.

😎Switch up your style with all new racquets and gear to kit out your avatar.
🥇Play with friends and compete against others to gain MMR points.
📇 Track your stats on the player card!
